speaker: Sheldon
text: I think I'm sick. Leonard? Leonard? Leonard? Leonard, my comforter fell down and my sinuses hurt when I bend over. Leonard?

speaker: Sheldon
text: I'm at work. At 6:30 in the morning? On Sunday?

speaker: Leonard
text: Yes. They asked me to come in.

speaker: Sheldon
text: Why? I didn't hear the phone ring.

speaker: Sheldon
text: Well, as I predicted, I am sick. My fever has been tracking up exponentially since 2 a.m., and I am producing sputum at an alarming rate.

speaker: Sheldon
text: Nope. Not only that, it has shifted from clear to milky green.

speaker: Leonard
text: Alright, well, get some rest and drink plenty of fluids.

speaker: Sheldon
text: What else would I drink? Gases? Solids? I-nice plasma?

speaker: Leonard
text: Drink whatever you want. Then make soup. I'm at work, Sheldon.

speaker: Sheldon
text: I want soup. We don't have soup.
